levels.surface: عبد الله بن يحيى بن أبي كثير

notes: «وأثنى عليه خيرا لقيته باليمامة» is an editor remark, left out of the surface
The second group starts «وعن أبيه» (a back reference) and has the same saying («مثله»): a second isnad, not a variant
The last link of the second group is the father of عبد الله بن أبي قتادة, named by relation only
